headline: Bank Indonesia Records Base Money Reaching Rp2,254.5 Trillion in July 2026, Growing 17.1 Percent
summary: Bank Indonesia reported base money reached Rp2,254.5 trillion in July 2026, up 17.1 percent year on year and higher than in June.
why: Base money, also called high-powered money, is the central bank's core monetary liability and underpins broader credit and liquidity conditions. Bank Indonesia publishes it monthly as a gauge of monetary policy.
